hypotheses_predeclared.H1_operator: TruncatedLinear(100) only acts where |g| h_ref < 0.1, so it damps nearly-regular bulk corrections (|g| h_ref ~ 1e-2) but leaves the free-surface displacement (|g| h_ref ~ 1.17) bit-identical to NoLimiter.
hypotheses_predeclared.H2_physics: On the free-surface dominated dam break the limiter changes the Martin & Moyce MAE by less than 0.02 in Z/a (13 % of the 0.15 gate) at both resolutions and flips no gate verdict, i.e. the missing limiter does not explain the residual error of the NoLimiter runs.
hypotheses_predeclared.H3_scope: If H2 holds it is because the correction is surface-driven: the share of particles with limiter < 1 in a dam-break state stays below 50 % while their contribution to the maximum displacement is ~0.
